General Information

What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Tie Rod End that attaches to the Tie Rod Assembly.
This Tie Rod End Simply screws into the the LH end of the Tie Rod and from there it mounts into the LH Steering Knuckle .
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Tie Rod End
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki X90 All Years
